verbalization: The compound (1R,4R,6S,8aR)-4,8a-dimethyl-6-propan-2-yl-1,2,3,6,7,8-hexahydronaphthalene-1,4-diol is associated with the Prostaglandin D2 receptor through a multi-step pathway.
